diagnosis: An authenticated user can submit arbitrary policy_id values to queue destructive data-purge jobs in the lifespan retention queue. The route does not verify policy.organization_id == current_user.organization_id, allowing an attacker to trigger irreversible deletion of another tenant's historical records.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/v1/compliance/retention-policies/884/execute HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
